I’m excited to share that I’ve joined BDR as Chief Executive Officer. What drew me to BDR was its outstanding reputation, talented team, and unwavering commitment to helping residential home service contractors build stronger, more successful businesses. From my first conversations, it was clear that this is a company with a strong culture, a meaningful mission, and tremendous opportunities ahead. I’m grateful to founder Bruce Wiseman for the opportunity to build upon the exceptional company he and the team have created. I’m also excited to partner with Southfield Capital, whose long-term vision and commitment to building great businesses make them an outstanding partner for BDR’s next chapter. I look forward to working alongside the incredible BDR team, our coaches, clients, and partners as we continue to serve the HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and skilled trades industries. Thank you to everyone who has supported me throughout my career. I’m excited for this next chapter and all that lies ahead.
